title: Restriction bound for shrinking decision-tree depth
statement:
Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function on $n\ge 1$ variables, and let $d\ge 2$, $s\ge 1$, $w\ge 1$, and $l\ge 1$ be positive integers together with an integer threshold $t\ge 0$. Suppose $f$ is computed by some Boolean circuit of depth at most $d$, size at most $s$ (counting gates and literal leaves), and fan-in at most $w$. Let $\rho$ be a Bernoulli random restriction on the $n$ variables with survival parameter
\[
  p = \frac{1}{40w}\left(\frac{1}{40l}\right)^{d-2},
\]
so that each variable is independently left free with probability $p$ and otherwise fixed to $0$ or to $1$, each with probability $(1-p)/2$. Write $f\restriction_\rho$ for the function obtained from $f$ by substituting the values $\rho$ assigns and keeping the free coordinates as inputs, and let $D(g)$ denote the least depth of a decision tree computing a Boolean function $g$. Then
\[
  \bbP\!\left[D(f\restriction_\rho) > t\right]
  \;\le\; (s-1)\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{l} + \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{t}
    + (s-1)\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120\,w}\right)
    + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120\,l}\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f computed by a circuit of depth ≤ d, size ≤ s, and fan-in ≤ w
random restriction is Bernoulli with survival parameter composedDelta(w, l, d)
replaced:
By strong induction on the depth $d\ge 2$: if $f$ is computed by a circuit of depth at most
$d$, size at most $s$, and fan-in at most $w$ (with $s,w,l,n>0$), then under
$\mathrm{composedDelta}(w,l,d)$,
\[
  \Pr\!\left[\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,f\,\rho) > t\right]
  \le (s-1)(1/2)^{l} + (1/2)^{t} + (s-1)\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right)
    + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
